Some properties of element X are listed.
1
It forms coloured compounds.
2
It has a high melting point.
3
It has a high density.
Which properties show that X is a transition element?
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
1 and 3 only
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Chemistry
